title: Version joint groups and preserve owned visits
source_finding: Legacy conversations cannot be migrated; acceptance must preserve parent metadata, serialize capacity and authorize replay.

title: Project one authorized conversation and gate old clients
source_finding: Filtering must precede canonical pagination; union audience, aliases and legacy RPCs require explicit authorization.

title: Implement versioned consent, owned mutations and reliable retries
source_finding: Existing visibility is parent-level; private saves, generation changes and account switches cannot corrupt personal history.

title: Render the shared card consistently on every surface
source_finding: Profiles must foreground their subject while every surface uses one shared engagement identity.

title: Execute compatibility, race, privacy and rollout gates
source_finding: Existing legacy tests do not prove the new contract; ship requires evidence for the full acceptance matrix.
